packageRules.description: The pip package and the base image must move together: the library looks for the browser build its own version shipped with, and the image only carries its own. The shared preset already holds PyPI updates for three days (security:minimumReleaseAgePypi); without the same gate on the image, the Docker half of this group goes alone during that window -- which is how v0.4.21 shipped a 1.63 image with a 1.62 library and every run failed at browser launch.
